verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents nineteen system-wide themes, selectable via Style > Theme. A theme restyles the terminal, bar, notifications and wallpaper at once, and users can create custom themes with Aether. This suggests a way to get a darker look, but the evidence never explicitly mentions a dark mode or any night-light or blue-light feature. Missing for 10: an explicit dark-mode toggle or documented dark themes, night-light/blue-light filtering, and independent corroboration.
